licence.title: Physician Assistant License
licence.renewalDeadline: December 31 every other year (renewal opens October 1 of the expiry year); biennial since August 1, 2023
licence.compactNote: NDCC 43-17-02.1(1) recognises a PA Licensure Compact privilege under chapter 43-17.5; whether the compact is issuing privileges yet was not confirmed.

ce.categoryRules: No state CME hour count for PAs in NDAC 50-03-01; the state requirement is current NCCPA (or board-approved) certification, so the NCCPA CME and PANRE/PANRE-LA requirements are what the PA must meet

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No written agreement for PAs practicing at a licensed health care facility, a facility with a credentialing and privileging system, or a physician-owned facility or practice. A PA with fewer than 4,000 hours who practices outside those settings (board-approved practice) must execute a written collaborative agreement with a North Dakota physician, kept and provided to the Board on request. Independent practice outside those settings requires Board approval (rural underserved location plus periodic physician chart review).
practice.notes: PA must report to the Board within 10 days if NCCPA certification is lost; the licence then automatically expires. Practice location must be verified on renewal.

prescribing.ceForPrescribers: None found in PA rules; DEA registration required to prescribe controlled substances (NDCC 43-17-02.1(4)(f))

rn.renewalDeadline: Before December 31 of the second calendar year
rn.practiceHours: At least 400 nursing practice hours within the preceding 4 years
rn.ceNote: 12 contact hours in the preceding 2 years; no CE before the first renewal after licensure by examination (NDBON CE page); excess hours do not carry forward

aprn.title: APRN with role designation (for NPs: APRN, certified nurse practitioner; APRN-CNP)
aprn.renewalDeadline: Same period as the RN licence (December 31 of the second year)
aprn.ceNote: No APRN-specific CE hour count beyond the RN requirement; renewal requires current national certification (or a board-recognized competence maintenance program)
aprn.pharmacologyNote: 15 contact hours of pharmacotherapy every 2 years applies to APRNs holding prescriptive authority; these hours may also count toward the RN 12 hours; certificates must itemize pharmacology CE and UpToDate certificates do not count (NDBON CE page)
aprn.renewalNote: Renewal requires a current RN licence in North Dakota or a compact state, the APRN renewal application, fee, and current national certification (NDAC 54-05-03.1-06).

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Prescriptive authority is a separate application added to the APRN licence (initial: 30 contact hours pharmacotherapy within 3 years before application)
prescribing.notes: Own DEA number required before prescribing controlled substances; PDMP review required for new controlled substance patients and every 6 months during treatment

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No physician collaboration agreement in NDAC 54-05-03.1; the rule on changes in physician collaboration for prescriptive authority was repealed effective October 1, 2011.

unverified: PA licence cycle: the Board renewal page (updated 3/23/2026) says PA licences expire every other year on Dec. 31, but NDAC 50-03-01-13 still states fees 'per year' and 50-03-01-17 still says 'annual registration process'. The Board page is the newer source; which calendar years a given licence expires is not stated, so use the expiry date on the licence.

PA CE: NDAC 50-03-01 sets no state CME hour count; renewal requires current NCCPA (or board-approved) certification, so NCCPA's own CME and PANRE/PANRE-LA rules govern. acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieu=true means certification is the whole state requirement, not a substitute for a state hour count.

State CS registration (PA and NP): NDCC 19-03.1-16(1) requires anyone who dispenses to 'obtain annually a registration issued by the board', but no Board of Pharmacy practitioner registration rule, form or page was found. Show as not yet verified with https://www.nodakpharmacy.com.
NP: 'full' practice authority is inferred from NDAC 54-05-03.1 (no collaboration or supervision rule; 54-05-03.1-12 repealed 2011) and NDCC 43-12.1; no transition-to-practice hours found.
NP: ND enacted the APRN Licensure Compact (NDCC 43-12.5); whether it is operational was not confirmed.
PA: whether the PA Licensure Compact (NDCC 43-17.5) is issuing privileges yet was not confirmed.

PA and NP: no state topic mandate (opioid/pain, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide prevention, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence) was found in NDAC 50-03-01, NDAC 54-02-05, NDAC 54-05-03.1, NDCC 43-17 or the NDBON CE page. The 1-hour nutrition and metabolic health CE in NDCC 43-17-27.1(2) applies to physicians only. Federal DEA MATE (one-time 8 hours) still applies to DEA registrants.
